arxiv-2104-14747.title: Heat conduction in a three-dimensional momentum-conserving fluid
arxiv-2104-14747.creator: Rongxiang Luo, Lisheng Huang, Stefano Lepri
arxiv-2104-14747.description: Abstract Size-dependence of energy transport and the effects of reduced dimensionality on transport coefficients are of key importance for understanding nonequilibrium properties of matter on the nanoscale. Here, we perform nonequilibrium and equilibrium simulations of heat conduction in a 3D fluid with the multiparticle collision dynamics, interacting with two thermal-walls.

arxiv-2105-03412.title: Comment on “Massive electrodynamics and the magnetic monopoles”
arxiv-2105-03412.creator: Michael Dunia, Timothy J. Evans, Douglas Singleton
arxiv-2105-03412.description: Abstract In this paper we correct previous work on magnetic charge plus a photon mass. We show that contrary to previous claims this system has a very simple, closed form solution which is the Dirac string potential multiplied by a exponential decaying part.

arxiv-2202-05119.title: Universal catastrophe time distributions of dynamically unstable polymers
arxiv-2202-05119.creator: Paul B. Dieterle, Jenny Zheng, Ethan Garner, Ariel Amir
arxiv-2202-05119.description: Abstract Dynamic instability — the growth, catastrophe, and shrinkage of quasi-one-dimensional filaments — has been observed in multiple biopolymers. Scientists have long understood the catastrophic cessation of growth and subsequent depolymerization as arising from the interplay of hydrolysis and polymerization at the tip of the polymer.

arxiv-2205-02535.title: Five-loop anomalous dimensions of ϕ 𝑸 \phi^{Q} operators in a scalar theory with 𝑶 ⁡ ( 𝑵 ) O(N) symmetry
arxiv-2205-02535.creator: Qingjun Jin, Yi Li
arxiv-2205-02535.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Qingjun Jin, Yi Li. We compute the complete Q Q -dependence of anomalous dimensions of traceless symmetric tensor operator ϕ Q \phi^{Q} in O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) scalar theory to five-loop. The renormalization factors are extracted from ϕ Q → Q ​ ϕ \phi^{Q}\rightarrow Q\phi form factors, and the integrand of form factors are constructed with the help of unitarity cut method.

arxiv-2211-02363.title: Neural RELAGGS
arxiv-2211-02363.creator: Lukas Pensel, Stefan Kramer
arxiv-2211-02363.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Lukas Pensel, Stefan Kramer. Multi-relational databases are the basis of most consolidated data collections in science and industry today. Most learning and mining algorithms, however, require data to be represented in a propositional form. While there is a variety of specialized machine learning algorithms that can operate directly on multi-relational data sets, propositionalization algorithms transform multi-relational databases into propositional data sets, thereby allowing the application of traditional machine learning and data mining algorithms without their modification.

arxiv-2307-12339.title: Temporal network analysis: Introduction, methods and detailed tutorial with R
arxiv-2307-12339.creator: Mohammed Saqr
arxiv-2307-12339.description: Abstract Learning involves relations, interactions and connections between learners, teachers and the world at large. Such interactions are essentially temporal and unfold in time. Yet, researchers have rarely combined the two aspects (the temporal and relational aspects) in an analytics framework. Temporal networks allow modeling of the temporal learning processes i.e.

arxiv-2308-02672.title: New estimates for bounded oscillation operators Thanks: The work was supported by the Science Committee of RA, in the frames of the research project 21AG‐1A045
arxiv-2308-02672.creator: Grigori A. Karagulyan
arxiv-2308-02672.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Grigori A. Karagulyan. Bounded oscillation ( BO {\rm BO} ) operators were recently introduced and studied in [ 15 ] . Those are operators running on abstract measure spaces equipped with a ball-basis. It was proved that many operators in harmonic analysis (Calderón-Zygmund operators and their maximally modulations, Carleson type operators, martingale transforms, Littlewood-Paley square functions, maximal function, etc) are BO {\rm BO} operators. Various properties of BO {\rm BO} operators were studied in [ 16 , 15 ] .

arxiv-2502-01163.title: Minimum Riesz s-Energy Subset Selection in Ordered Point Sets via Dynamic Programming
arxiv-2502-01163.creator: Michael T.M. Emmerich
arxiv-2502-01163.description: Abstract We present a dynamic programming algorithm for selecting a representative subset of size k k from a given set with n n points such that the Riesz s s -energy is near minimized. While NP-hard in general dimensions, the one-dimensional case can use the natural data ordering for efficient dynamic programming as an effective heuristic solution approach.

arxiv-2506-16400.title: Physical-Layer Signal Injection Attacks on EV Charging Ports: Bypassing Authentication via Electrical-Level Exploits
arxiv-2506-16400.creator: Hetian Shi, Yi He, Shangru Song, Jianwei Zhuge, Jian Mao
arxiv-2506-16400.description: Abstract The proliferation of electric vehicles in recent years has significantly expanded the charging infrastructure while introducing new security risks to both vehicles and chargers. In this paper, we investigate the security of major charging protocols such as SAE J1772, CCS, IEC 61851, GB/T 20234, and NACS, uncovering new physical signal spoofing attacks in their authentication mechanisms.

arxiv-2601-06023.title: Weak lensing of bright standard sirens: prospects for σ 8 \sigma_{8}
arxiv-2601-06023.creator: Ville Vaskonen
arxiv-2601-06023.description: Abstract Gravitational wave events with electromagnetic counterparts provide direct measurements of the Hubble diagram. We demonstrate that incorporating weak lensing into bright standard siren analyses allows measurements of cosmological parameters that do not influence the mean luminosity distance-redshift relation but do impact the cosmic structures.

pmc-10572604.title: Isolation and Characterization of Thermus thermophilus Strain ET-1: An Extremely Thermophilic Bacterium with Extracellular Thermostable Proteolytic Activity Isolated from El Tatio Geothermal Field, Antofagasta, Chile
pmc-10572604.creator: Bernardita Valenzuela, Francisco Solís-Cornejo, Rubén Araya, Pedro Zamorano, Emilia Pedone
pmc-10572604.description: The present study describes the isolation of an extremely thermophilic bacterium from El Tatio, a geyser field in the high planes of Northern Chile. The thermophile bacterium named Thermus thermophilus strain ET-1 showed 99% identity with T. thermophilus SGO.5JP 17-16 (GenBank accession No. CP002777) by 16S rDNA gene analysis.

pmc-10660923.title: Assessing the burden of HPV-related head and neck cancers in mainland China: protocol of a nationwide, multisite, cross-sectional study
pmc-10660923.creator: Wei Wang, Cheng Song, Zheng Su, Smita Kothari, Ya-Ting Chen, Yin Liu, Shu-Yu Wu, Ravi Panchal, Edith Morais, Shao-Kai Zhang, Jian Yin, You-Lin Qiao, Craig Roberts
pmc-10660923.description: BackgroundPersistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is a known cause of a subset of head and neck cancers (HNCs). In the last two decades, the proportion of HNCs attributable to HPV infection has increased worldwide, notably the oropharyngeal cancers. However, the trend of HPV-related HNC burden is not clearly understood yet in China.

pmc-11461707.title: Coupling Taguchi experimental designs with deep adaptive learning enhanced AI process models for experimental cost savings in manufacturing process development
pmc-11461707.creator: Syed Wasim Hassan Zubair, Syed Muhammad Arafat, Sarmad Ali Khan, Sajawal Gul Niazi, Muhammad Rehan, Muhammad Usama Arshad, Nasir Hayat, Tauseef Aized, Ghulam Moeen Uddin, Fahid Riaz
pmc-11461707.description: The Aluminum alloy AA7075 workpiece material is observed under dry finishing turning operation. This work is an investigation reporting promising potential of deep adaptive learning enhanced artificial intelligence process models for L18 (6133) Taguchi orthogonal array experiments and major cost saving potential in machining process optimization.

pmc-11465488.title: Anchorage loss of the posterior teeth under different extraction patterns in maxillary and mandibular arches using clear aligner: a finite element study
pmc-11465488.creator: Ruyue Qiang, Jie Gao, Yanqi Wang, Wei Wang, Yanning Ma, Zuolin Jin
pmc-11465488.description: BackgroundExtracting the premolars is an effective strategy for patients with bimaxillary dentoalveolar protrusion. Clear aligners (CAs) close the extraction spaces through shortening the length of aligners. The contraction force generated by the terminal of aligners makes the posterior teeth tip mesially, which is known as the roller coaster effect. This phenomenon is even worse in the 2nd premolar extraction cases.

pmc-11792159.title: Evaluation of BR1 and BI30 AAVs for Brain Endothelial Tropism
pmc-11792159.creator: Felecia M. Marottoli, Deebika Balu, Rohan Chaudhary, Sarah E. Lutz, Leon M. Tai
pmc-11792159.description: Brain endothelial cells are critical for homeostasis of the central nervous system. Novel adeno-associated viruses (AAV) with brain endothelial cell tropism have been developed and are beginning to be employed in mechanistic and therapeutic research. Studies using AAVs can be involved in terms of cost, time and personnel, and many groups, including our own, are not experts on the technology.

pmc-12421663.title: Impact of Anionic Dopants on H Atom Uptake at Polyoxovanadate-Alkoxide Surfaces
pmc-12421663.creator: M. Rebecca A. Walls, Rachel L. Meyer, William W. Brennessel, Ellen M. Matson
pmc-12421663.description: Proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) is an important mechanism that defines the reactivity of H atom equivalents at reducible metal oxide (MO x ) surfaces. To better understand structure–function properties that dictate the thermochemistry and kinetics of PCET at MO x surfaces, our group has employed polyoxovanadate-alkoxide (POV-alkoxide) complexes as molecular models of extended materials.

pmc-12531715.title: Island Biogeography in the Anthropocene: Natural and Anthropogenic Drivers of Plant Diversity in the Miaodao Archipelago
pmc-12531715.creator: Haitao Yu, Xue Feng, Yuhuang Lin, Ying Yang, Zixiong Song, Shie Ching Ang, Qingchun Wang
pmc-12531715.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Island ecosystems are particularly sensitive to natural and anthropogenic environmental changes, and island plant communities undergo restructuring driven by multiple interacting factors. However, how these factors collectively influence species diversity and community composition on temperate inhabited islands remains unclear. This study assessed changes in vascular plant diversity across spatial gradients of area, isolation, climate, and human disturbance on 10 inhabited islands in Miaodao Archipelago.

pmc-12587196.title: Facility-Based Uptake of Colorectal Cancer Screening in 45- to 49-Year-Olds After US Guideline Changes
pmc-12587196.creator: Alyssa H. Harris, Hannah R. Murphy, Madeleine McDowell, Margaret E. Wright, M. Courtney Hughes
pmc-12587196.description: This cohort study examines facility-based uptake of colorectal cancer screening among adults aged 45 to 49 years after changes in US guidelines. Introduction Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains the second leading cause of cancer-related mortality in the US.1 Although incidence among adults aged 65 years and older has declined, rates among those younger than 50 years increased 2.

pmc-13276729.title: The Diet Guidelines: 3 Diets (DG3D) study protocol of a behavioral teaching kitchen intervention for type-2 diabetes prevention among African American adults
pmc-13276729.creator: Shiba Bailey, Gabrielle M. Turner-McGrievy, Enid A. Keseko, Taylor Duncan, Denine Ward-Johnson, Briana Davis, Sara Wilcox, Daniela B. Friedman, Mark A. Sarzynski, Angela D. Liese
pmc-13276729.description: Background:The U.S. Dietary Guidelines (USDG) serve as a foundational public health resource, yet their cultural applicability to underserved populations, including Black and African American (AA) adults, remains limited. The AA population is disproportionately affected by obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), highlighting the need for culturally tailored interventions.

pmc-13475029.title: Hydatid Pulmonary Embolism Complicating Hepatopulmonary Hydatid Disease: A Case Report
pmc-13475029.creator: Leila Salak, Soumia Fdil, Dalal Zagaouch, Khalid Bouti, Sanaa Hammi
pmc-13475029.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Hydatid disease is an endemic parasitic infection that primarily affects the liver and lungs. Hydatid pulmonary embolism is an exceptional and potentially severe complication, usually resulting from the rupture of a hydatid cyst into the venous circulation. We report the case of a 64-year-old patient, a former smoker from a rural area, who had been diagnosed with hepatopulmonary hydatid disease complicated by chronic bilateral hydatid pulmonary embolism two years before the current admission. Echinococcosis serology was positive.

pmc-13568451.title: Frequency-Offset-Estimation-Assisted Transformer Neural Equalization for a 4.6 km Optical-Heterodyne RoF–Wireless OFDM Link
pmc-13568451.creator: Zhihang Ou, Wen Zhou, Ye Zhou, Jiali Chen, Xin Lu, Hansong Ma, Sicong Xu, Jie Zhang, Hanyu Zhang, Yubin Zhang, Jianjun Yu
pmc-13568451.description: To address the issues of subcarrier orthogonality loss and inter-carrier interference (ICI) caused by carrier frequency offset (CFO), this paper proposes and experimentally validates a frequency offset estimation (FOE)-assisted dual-domain Transformer equalizer within an advanced, high-capacity optical-heterodyne radio-over-fiber (RoF)–wireless orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) transmission system.
